name: Clomic F Oinment 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About CLOMIC F OINMENT

CLOMIC F OINMENT is a combination of Clobetasol and Fusidic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics respectively. It is used to manage skin infections such as impetigo (crusty and swollen patch on the skin with pus), psoriasis (itching), eczema, or dermatitis. It can also be used to manage cuts and wounds which are infected.

Eczema or dermatitis is a term for several different types of skin swelling that cause dry, itchy skin and rashes on the face, elbows, behind the knees, and on the hands and feet.

During course of the management your doctor might regularly examine your skin to avoid any unwanted side effects.

Avoid smoking while using CLOMIC F OINMENT. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

CLOMIC F OINMENT is not recommended for use in children (ages less than 1 year). Before using CLOMIC F OINMENT, inform your doctor if you have skin conditions like acne, rosacea, perioral dermatitis, viral or fungal skin infections, blisters caused by any infection, or if you are using it on your child.

CLOMIC F OINMENT should be used with caution in pregnant women. CLOMIC F OINMENT is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The most common side effect of using CLOMIC F OINMENT is skin irritation. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: Diplomax Lotion 25ml
introduction:
Introduction About DIPLOMAX LOTION

DIPLOMAX LOTION is a combination of Clobetasol propionate and Salicylic acid which belongs to a group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids and Keratolytic agents, respectively. DIPLOMAX LOTION is used to manage and provide relief from inflammatory manifestations of skin conditions such as psoriasis (skin condition marked by rash and itchiness), and eczema (skin inflammation) in affected individuals. DIPLOMAX LOTION is also used to provide relief from skin redness, itching, and/or swelling due to various skin conditions. It is also indicated for use to manage other skin conditions such as dermatoses (skin lesion), seborrheic dermatitis of scalp and/or ichthyosis vulgaris (inherited skin condition marked by dry & scaly skin) in affected individuals.

DIPLOMAX LOTION is generally not recommended for use in patients allergic to Clobetasol, and/or Salicylic acid. DIPLOMAX LOTION is advised to be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. DIPLOMAX LOTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 12 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side-effects associated with the use of DIPLOMAX LOTION are irritation, burning, redness, and/or stinging sensation (at the site of application), skin rash, itching, and/or peeling/ thinning of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How DIPLOMAX LOTION Works

DIPLOMAX LOTION provides relief from psoriasis and eczema, where Clobetasol propionate manages inflammation by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen, and/or itchy. Salicylic acid softens the skin by removing dead skin cells and breaking down keratin clumps which results in reducing itchiness and redness of skin, thus providing relief from psoriasis and eczema in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use DIPLOMAX LOTION

Always apply DIPLOMAX LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands and apply a thin layer of medicine on the affected area. Avoid covering the affected area with airtight dressings unless recommended. Avoid applying the medicine on face, groin, or axillae. Your doctor will decide the correct dose. and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SIMBIOTIC B LOTION

SIMBIOTIC B LOTION is a combination of Beclomethasone and Clotrimazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids and Antibiotics, respectively. SIMBIOTIC B LOTION is used to relieve the inflammatory manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses when complicated by secondary infection caused by organisms sensitive to the components of this dermatologic preparation or when the possibility of such infection is suspected. It is also used to manage athlete's foot, jock itch, ringworm, allergic rhinitis, jock itch, oral thrush, fungal infections of armpit and skin folds.

A fungal infection also called mycosis, is a skin disease caused by a fungus. It causes irritation, scaly skin, redness, itching, swelling and blisters.

SIMBIOTIC B LOTION is not recommended for use in patients having skin problems such as acne, rosacea (severe flushing of skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around mouth), viral & fungal infections.

Before applying SIMBIOTIC B LOTION, inform your doctor if you have psoriasis (itchy skin), liver disease and allergic reaction to any substance.

SIMBIOTIC B LOTION should be used with caution during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women only if it is necessary.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 2 years). Consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine.

The most common side effects are irritation, burning or stinging sensation, itchy rash, red, itchy skin, and blistering at the site of application. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects gets worse.

Used to manage skin infections
mechanismOfAction:
How SIMBIOTIC B LOTION Works

SIMBIOTIC B LOTION is a combination of Beclometasone and Clotrimazole which manage skin infections. Beclometasone is a steroid which blocks the production of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) that make the skin red, swollen and itchy. Clotrimazole is an antifungal which stops the growth of fungi on the skin by managing them from forming their own protective covering.

name: Flucort Skin Cream 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About FLUCORT SKIN CREAM

FLUCORT SKIN CREAM contains Fluocinolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is indicated for the relief of the inflammatory and pruritic (irritating, itchy) symptoms of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses (skin conditions that can be managed with corticosteroid medicines).

Before using FLUCORT SKIN CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any skin infections or if you are using any other medicines. FLUCORT SKIN CREAM should be used in pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby and should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

Caution should be exercised while using FLUCORT SKIN CREAM in children so, consult your child’s doctor for advice. Patients may experience local reactions like burning, itching, irritation, dryness, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.
uses: Used to relieve the inflammatory and pruritic symptoms of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses
usesDetails:
Uses Of FLUCORT SKIN CREAM
Used to relieve the inflammatory and pruritic symptoms of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses
mechanismOfAction:
How FLUCORT SKIN CREAM Works

FLUCORT SKIN CREAM reduces the swelling and constriction of the blood vessels by inhibiting the factors that cause swelling and inflammation. It also blocks the pathway of certain substances that cause inflammation (prostaglandins).
usageDetails:
How to use FLUCORT SKIN CREAM

Always apply FLUCORT SKIN CREAM as directed by your physician. Apply a thin film of FLUCORT SKIN CREAM over the affected area. It is for external use only. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth.

In hairy sites, the hair should be parted to allow direct contact with the affected area. Wash hands before and after the application of FLUCORT SKIN CREAM. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of FLUCORT SKIN CREAM management depending on your age, weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: HPA axis suppression (detected by certain tests)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of FLUCORT SKIN CREAM
Rare

Stop using FLUCORT SKIN CREAM and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

HPA axis suppression (detected by certain tests)
Skin irritation

Introduction About NIOSOL OINTMENT

NIOSOL OINTMENT contains Clobetasol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical corticosteroids. It is used in adults and adolescents (aged 12 years or above) to manage inflammatory skin conditions such as psoriasis, eczema and dermatitis that have not responded to milder steroid creams or ointments.

Psoriasis is an immune-mediated skin disease that speeds up the growth cycle of skin cells, causing patches of thick red skin and silvery scales, typically on the elbows, knees, scalp, lower back, face, palms, and soles, but can affect other places also. Eczema (also called dermatitis) includes several different types of skin swelling, causing dry, itchy skin and rashes on the face, inside the elbows, behind the knees, and on the hands and feet. Scratching the skin can make it turn red, swell and itch even more.

NIOSOL OINTMENT is not recommended for use in patients with other bacterial, fungal, or viral infections (such as herpes simplex, chicken pox and tuberculosis). Before using NIOSOL OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you have a skin infection, diabetes, adrenal gland problem, scheduled surgery, acne, plaques around your mouth, underarms, anus, or genitals and liver diseases.

NIOSOL OINTMENT should be used during pregnancy only if recommended by your doctor. NIOSOL OINTMENT should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. NIOSOL OINTMENT is not recommended for use by children under 12 years of age. The most common side effects of using NIOSOL OINTMENT are thinning of the skin, widening of small veins in the skin, skin discomfort and dryness. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

introduction:
Introduction About NIOSALIC LOTION

NIOSALIC LOTION is a combination of Clobetasol propionate and Salicylic acid which belongs to a group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids and Keratolytic agents, respectively. NIOSALIC LOTION is used to manage and provide relief from inflammatory manifestations of skin conditions such as psoriasis (skin condition marked by rash and itchiness), and eczema (skin inflammation) in affected individuals. NIOSALIC LOTION is also used to provide relief from skin redness, itching, and/or swelling due to various skin conditions. It is also indicated for use to manage other skin conditions such as dermatoses (skin lesion), seborrheic dermatitis of scalp and/or ichthyosis vulgaris (inherited skin condition marked by dry & scaly skin) in affected individuals.

NIOSALIC LOTION is generally not recommended for use in patients allergic to Clobetasol, and/or Salicylic acid. NIOSALIC LOTION is advised to be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. NIOSALIC LOTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 12 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side-effects associated with the use of NIOSALIC LOTION are irritation, burning, redness, and/or stinging sensation (at the site of application), skin rash, itching, and/or peeling/ thinning of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

Salicylic acid softens the skin by removing dead skin cells and breaking down keratin clumps which results in reducing itchiness and redness of skin, thus providing relief from psoriasis and eczema in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUCORT H SKIN CREAM

FLUCORT H SKIN CREAM contains Fluocinolone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. It is indicated for the relief of the inflammatory and pruritic (irritating, itchy) symptoms of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses (skin conditions that can be managed with corticosteroid medicines).

Before using FLUCORT H SKIN CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any skin infections or if you are using any other medicines. FLUCORT H SKIN CREAM should be used in pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby and should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

Caution should be exercised while using FLUCORT H SKIN CREAM in children so, consult your child’s doctor for advice. Patients may experience local reactions like burning, itching, irritation, dryness, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.
uses: Used to relieve the inflammatory and pruritic symptoms of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses
usesDetails:
Uses Of FLUCORT H SKIN CREAM
Used to relieve the inflammatory and pruritic symptoms of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses
mechanismOfAction:
How FLUCORT H SKIN CREAM Works

FLUCORT H SKIN CREAM reduces the swelling and constriction of the blood vessels by inhibiting the factors that cause swelling and inflammation. It also blocks the pathway of certain substances that cause inflammation (prostaglandins).
usageDetails:
How to use FLUCORT H SKIN CREAM

Always apply FLUCORT H SKIN CREAM as directed by your physician. Apply a thin film of FLUCORT H SKIN CREAM over the affected area. It is for external use only. Avoid applying this medicine around your eyes, including eyelids, nose and mouth.

In hairy sites, the hair should be parted to allow direct contact with the affected area. Wash hands before and after the application of FLUCORT H SKIN CREAM. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of FLUCORT H SKIN CREAM management depending on your age, weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PROPYSALIC NF OINTMENT

PROPYSALIC NF OINTMENT is a combination of Clobetasol propionate and Salicylic acid which belongs to a group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids and Keratolytic agents, respectively. PROPYSALIC NF OINTMENT is used to manage and provide relief from inflammatory manifestations of skin conditions such as psoriasis (skin condition marked by rash and itchiness), and eczema (skin inflammation) in affected individuals. PROPYSALIC NF OINTMENT is also used to provide relief from skin redness, itching, and/or swelling due to various skin conditions. It is also indicated for use to manage other skin conditions such as dermatoses (skin lesion), seborrheic dermatitis of scalp and/or ichthyosis vulgaris (inherited skin condition marked by dry & scaly skin) in affected individuals.

PROPYSALIC NF OINTMENT is generally not recommended for use in patients allergic to Clobetasol, and/or Salicylic acid. PROPYSALIC NF OINTMENT is advised to be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. PROPYSALIC NF OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 12 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side-effects associated with the use of PROPYSALIC NF OINTMENT are irritation, burning, redness, and/or stinging sensation (at the site of application), skin rash, itching, and/or peeling/ thinning of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About UTREVA GEL

UTREVA GEL is a vaginal gel used in females to manage female infertility due to incorrect levels of progesterone during the menstrual cycle or when you are having an assisted fertility procedure.

It contains a medicine called Progesterone which is a synthetic female hormone. When the gel is inserted into your vagina, the progesterone will slowly release into your bloodstream throughout the day which mimics the actions of natural progesterone produced in your body.

UTREVA GEL is for vaginal use only. Gently insert the gel using the applicator into the vagina. Wash your hands before and after application. Before using this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems, asthma, diabetes, epilepsy, unexplained vaginal bleeding, migraine or history of depression as a precaution.

UTREVA GEL is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. It is normally not suggested during pregnancy, unless you have used this medicine to help become pregnancy. The most common side effects of using UTREVA GEL are breast tenderness, stomach cramps, pelvic pain, pain around genital area, vaginal discharge or itching, low sex drive, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

Talk to your doctor if you experience breast enlargement and pain after using this medicine.

Introduction About DOSETIL CREAM

DOSETIL CREAM contains Desonide which belongs to a group of medicines called Topical Corticosteroids. DOSETIL CREAM is used to relieve inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of corticosteroid-responsive dermatosis.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to take a urinary-free cortisol and ACTH (adrenocorticotropic hormone) stimulation test to evaluate HPA axis suppression (a condition that causes poor body defence against infection) especially in children to manage its effect in the body.

Before applying DOSETIL CREAM, inform your doctor if you are allergic to Desonide or any other ingredients in the medicine, and or have concomitant skin infections (infections caused by parasites).

DOSETIL CREAM should be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is necessary. Consult your doctor for advice.

DOSETIL CREAM is not recommended for use in children (less than 2 years of age). Consult your doctor before applying DOSETIL CREAM.

The most common side effects of applying DOSETIL CREAM are application site reactions such as burning, irritation, itching and redness, headache. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.

CLONEXT S OINTMENT is also used to provide relief from skin redness, itching, and/or swelling due to various skin conditions. It is also indicated for use to manage other skin conditions such as dermatoses (skin lesion), seborrheic dermatitis of scalp and/or ichthyosis vulgaris (inherited skin condition marked by dry & scaly skin) in affected individuals.

CLONEXT S OINTMENT is advised to be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. CLONEXT S OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 12 years). The medicine is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side-effects associated with the use of CLONEXT S OINTMENT are irritation, burning, redness, and/or stinging sensation (at the site of application), skin rash, itching, and/or peeling/ thinning of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

Introduction About PAEDISONE LOTION

PAEDISONE LOTION contains Clobetasol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical corticosteroids. It is used in adults and adolescents (aged 12 years or above) to manage inflammatory skin conditions such as psoriasis, eczema and dermatitis that have not responded to milder steroid creams or ointments.

Psoriasis is an immune-mediated skin disease that speeds up the growth cycle of skin cells, causing patches of thick red skin and silvery scales, typically on the elbows, knees, scalp, lower back, face, palms, and soles, but can affect other places also. Eczema (also called dermatitis) includes several different types of skin swelling, causing dry, itchy skin and rashes on the face, inside the elbows, behind the knees, and on the hands and feet. Scratching the skin can make it turn red, swell and itch even more.

PAEDISONE LOTION is not recommended for use in patients with other bacterial, fungal, or viral infections (such as herpes simplex, chicken pox and tuberculosis). Before using PAEDISONE LOTION, inform your doctor if you have a skin infection, diabetes, adrenal gland problem, scheduled surgery, acne, plaques around your mouth, underarms, anus, or genitals and liver diseases.

PAEDISONE LOTION should be used during pregnancy only if recommended by your doctor. PAEDISONE LOTION should be used with caution by breastfeeding women. PAEDISONE LOTION is not recommended for use by children under 12 years of age. The most common side effects of using PAEDISONE LOTION are thinning of the skin, widening of small veins in the skin, skin discomfort and dryness. Contact your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

Introduction About TOTALDERM CREAM

TOTALDERM CREAM is used to provide relief from skin infection, inflammation, itching, irritation, redness and swelling. It contains a combination of Beclomethasone, Clotrimazole and Neomycin.

Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine. It works by making your body not release certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling. Clotrimazole and neomycin stops the activity of microbes (fungi and bacteria) which when applied at the infected site.

TOTALDERM CREAM is strictly for external use only. Apply a thin layer of TOTALDERM CREAM on the affected skin areas. Avoid its contact with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose, or any open wounds. Do not use TOTALDERM CREAM for more than 4 weeks without consulting your doctor.

Before using TOTALDERM CREAM inform your doctor if you have any viral skin infections, skin ulcers, spotty red rash around the mouth, acne, rosacea (redness of skin) or itching of your anus (back passage) or genital areas as a precaution. Consult your doctor before using TOTALDERM CREAM if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of applying TOTALDERM CREAM are skin thinning and application site irritation and burning sensation. Consult your doctor if this side effect trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TOTALDERM CREAM Works

TOTALDERM CREAM contains three medicines, namely beclomethasone, clotrimazole and neomycin. Beclomethasone is a steroid medicine which stops your body from producing certain chemicals that causes inflammation and swelling, while parallelly making your body release chemicals that heals inflammation.

Clotrimazole is an antifungal medication which works by inhibiting the synthesis of ergosterol, an essential component of fungal cell membranes. Without ergosterol, the cell membranes become weakened and leaky, leading to fungal cell damage.

Neomycin is an antibiotic which stops protein synthesis in bacteria which is necessary for it to survive. As a result, it disrupts bacterial growth and replication and controls the spread of bacterial infection.

Apply a small amount of TOTALDERM CREAM into the affected skin areas or directed by the physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after application.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop using or overuse TOTALDERM CREAM without consulting your doctor.

Avoid contact of TOTALDERM CREAM with your eyes, mouth, ears, nose or with open wounds. In case of accidental contact, rinse with plenty of water.
